configuration.decision: Fixed before external scientific scores. Use all retained draws for primary summaries. Verify event integration on 128 evenly spaced draws per chain and train-only extremes; retain paired same-draw differences. Use independent probability-space Sobol clouds for cell recovery at both partitions, with all posterior draws at both transport resolutions. GP cell subdivision and selected-event quadrature are deterministic. No posterior, prior or model setting is selected by a score.

sampling_costs.scope: Original copula sampling and every GP selected-catalog production attempt, including failed and replayed sampling. Earlier pilots are in their own reports. Evaluation costs are separate; these are not end-to-end software speed comparisons.

recovery_refinement.posterior_transport: Use the already declared 2^16 verification cloud for final recovery, and compare with the retained independent 2^14 cloud at both partitions.
recovery_refinement.reason: The initial 48^3 check changes copula JS distances by about 0.0094 and GP distances by about 0.0055, exceeding 0.005. Most of this change is shared across models and comes from estimating truth cell probabilities by finite histograms. Integrate the known smooth truth density within each 48^3 cell using positive product Gauss-Legendre quadrature, and independently double its order. Retain the initial failed check. This declaration follows inspection of recovery distances and precedes the refined calculation; held-out copula predictive scores are not yet available.
recovery_refinement.scope: Numerical recovery evaluation only. Retain the declared 24^3 primary and 48^3 verification partitions, all posterior draws, both GP resolutions, all priors and the original acceptance thresholds. No model setting is selected by recovery or predictive performance.

recovery_scope: Joint recovery uses the common 48-cell primary and 96-cell verification partition. The declared 24-cell results and their failed precision test remain above and in the two prior summaries. All prediction and interval results are unchanged.

partition_refinement.reason: Deterministic truth integration removes histogram error, but the GP JS distances still change by 0.008--0.011 between 24 and 48 cells per axis. This exceeds the original 0.005 precision requirement. Use a common 48-cell partition with a 96-cell check for every model in this catalog, retaining the original 24-cell results. Use the same independent 2^14 and 2^16 posterior transport clouds, and positive within-cell quadrature of orders 2 and 4 on the finer partition. This is a numerical refinement after inspecting scores, not a new fit or a change of the scientific outcomes.
partition_refinement.scope: Selected-catalog joint recovery only. Preserve all posteriors, priors, fitted GP resolutions, likelihood and prediction, all original results, and the 0.005 acceptance threshold. No superiority claim is accepted until the common finer partition passes. Future cases must also pass this threshold on their reported recovery partitions.
